name: Building Production-Ready Agentic Workflows
postCreateCommand: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && curl -LsSf https://mistral.ai/vibe/install.sh | bash && curl -fsSL https://mistral.ai/cli/install.sh | MISTRAL_INSTALL_BUN=1 MISTRAL_NO_MODIFY_PATH=1 bash && make setup && sh scripts/bootstrap-env.sh

MISTRAL_API_KEY.description: Studio > API keys, in the workspace you will use all day.

SENTRY_CONNECTOR_NAME.description: Your Sentry connector's name as Studio shows it, e.g. sentry_d183.

GITHUB_CONNECTOR_NAME.description: Your GitHub connector's name as Studio shows it, e.g. github_app.

SENTRY_DSN.description: The DSN of the Sentry project that receives the six demo errors.
